How the score works

This is a practice estimate of delivery, not an assessment of eloquence, ideas, accent, or ability. It combines pace (40%), filler rate (40%), and immediate word repetition (20%). “Like” and “you know” are candidates, not always fillers. Recognition may omit hesitations and stutters. Repeated words are not a diagnosis of stuttering. Scores require at least 10 words and 5 seconds. Political argument mode shows descriptive delivery feedback without a numerical score.
